content: अनैकान्तिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Unsteady, uncertain; not to the point, not very important; भृत्योऽभृत्य इति ˚कमेतत् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²2 (in Logic) Name of one of the five main divisions of हेत्वाभास (fallacies), otherwise called सव्यभिचार. It is of three kinds:-- .³({%a%}) साधारण, where the हेतु is found both in the सपक्ष, and विपक्ष, the argument being therefore too general. .³({%b%}) असाधारण where the हेतु is in the पक्ष alone, the argument being not general enough. .³({%c%}) अनुपसंहारी which embraces every known thing in the पक्ष, the argument being non-conclusive.
